Templates are verified by the server. Secret fields are never added to a draft or summary.
Instance is already bound to this template version.
Current ports, workload, mounts, required configuration or resources do not meet the target template requirements. Edit the definition explicitly, then preview again.

Catalog refreshes do not change instances. Review the exact version, image diff and update notes before confirming. Updates retain the current definition and volumes; revision rollback does not restore databases or volume data.
Selected template version is unavailable. Refresh the catalog and check again.

Enter the server URL and a valid account. Server Center can verify an SSH host key and connect to a managed installation. Review the fingerprint before trusting it. Saved passwords require the local vault unlock. For Windows device-key login, pair the workstation first.
Browse, transfer and edit server files. SAF selects phone documents without broad storage access.

Open the existing three-language Docker installation and removal guides in an external browser. Some desktop instructions apply only on the target desktop or host. Repository access may require your browser account.

Use Server Center to verify SSH access and the host key, then install RelaxKonOS Server from an official release, a ZIP on this phone, or a ZIP on the host. The deployment page also provides reviewed upgrade, repair and uninstall actions. Check the original receipt and host health before connecting; runtime managers provide separate installation flows after login.

Application deployment installs remote workloads. A desktop .roapp is a different package and cannot run in this Android client. Web services open through an external application without client login credentials.

A lost response does not prove failure. Read the original operation or recovery record before submitting again. Refresh observes facts; it does not repeat the change. Server tasks continue according to their own cancellation rules. SSH forwards have an explicit notification stop action and never restart automatically after process exit.
Sign in to see the tasks supported by your server.
Available entries follow this server capability list. Opening an entry does not execute a host change; write actions require their own review and authorization.
Run an explicit server terminal session. Closing or backgrounding the view stops observation; session lifecycle remains explicit.
No reading has been taken yet.

The host OS denied termination. Adjust permissions on the host; this endpoint does not use an app administrator grant.
The original process exited or its PID now belongs to a different instance. Refresh the list before choosing another target.
The instance start time is unavailable. This process cannot be terminated here.
The host could not terminate this process. Refresh the list and check host permissions.
Terminate “%1$s” (PID %2$d, started %3$s)? Only this confirmed process instance is targeted.
Termination could not be verified. Refresh the process list to check; the operation will not be replayed automatically.

These workflows are part of this client version and update together. Server capabilities determine which entries are available; authorization is checked separately.
Android manages this signed application, its permissions, storage and uninstallation. Clearing its storage removes saved connections and credentials; it does not delete remote host data.
Desktop .roapp and desktop shell packages cannot run on Android. Their versions, permissions, updates, private data and removal are managed on the target desktop client.
Manage containers, revisions and runtime installation in their native management pages. Android app permissions do not grant host administrator access.
